instruction:
Write a Dockerfile for a Python 3.12 Flask application.
- requirements.txt lists dependencies
- app.py is the entry point
- App listens on port 5000
output:
FROM python:3.12-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY . .
EXPOSE 5000
CMD ["python", "app.py"]

instruction:

instruction:
Write a Dockerfile for a Python 3.11 Selenium WebDriver container.
- requirements.txt includes selenium
- Chrome browser must be installed
- Script test.py runs on start
output:
FROM python:3.11-slim
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y wget gnupg \
    && wget -q -O - https://dl.google.com/linux/linux_signing_key.pub | apt-key add - \
    && echo "deb [arch=amd64] http://dl.google.com/linux/chrome/deb/ stable main" >> /etc/apt/sources.list.d/google.list \
    && apt-get update && apt-get install -y google-chrome-stable \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY . .
CMD ["python", "test.py"]

instruction:
Write a Dockerfile for a Python 3.12 FastAPI app with poetry dependency management.
- pyproject.toml and poetry.lock are present
- app/main.py contains the FastAPI app
- Port 8000
output:
FROM python:3.12-slim
WORKDIR /app
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir poetry
COPY pyproject.toml poetry.lock ./
RUN poetry config virtualenvs.create false && poetry install --no-interaction --no-ansi
COPY . .
EXPOSE 8000
CMD ["uvicorn", "app.main:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8000"]

instruction:
Write a multi-stage Dockerfile for a Python 3.12 app that compiles a C extension.
- Builder stage installs build tools and compiles
- Final stage is slim runtime only
- requirements.txt, setup.py, and app.py are present
- Port 5000
output:
FROM python:3.12 AS builder
WORKDIR /app
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y gcc
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY . .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir .

FROM python:3.12-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=builder /usr/local/lib/python3.12/site-packages /usr/local/lib/python3.12/site-packages
COPY --from=builder /app /app
EXPOSE 5000
CMD ["python", "app.py"]
